queries: GPT-4 elementary errors prompt variations reasoning robustness study

sources_considered.why: Original controlled experiments on GPT-4, including elementary transformations and closely matched task variants.
Relevant reliability study, but the accessible read_page text contained only the abstract and did not establish the GPT-4-specific results.

evidence_items.explanation: GPT-4 achieved 76% accuracy joining first letters but 3% joining second letters, and 80% sorting words alphabetically but 32% in reverse order. These controlled differences support recurring elementary mistakes and unexpectedly uneven performance, although the authors also successfully predicted broad patterns from task frequency.

unresolved_gaps: The experiments do not estimate the frequency of elementary errors in ordinary user traffic.
Difficulty predicting individual failures is inferred from controlled performance differences; this study did not directly test users' advance predictions.
